title: Wood Frogs Survive 16 Degrees Below Freezing
hook: A wood frog survives 16 degrees below freezing, then moves again.
closing: This frog shows that frozen does not always mean dead.
question: Would you believe this frog survived?

segments.say: Wood frogs survive with 65% of body water frozen; most vertebrates die at 10%.
Wood frogs survive 16 degrees below freezing while typical frogs reach only 2.
Wood frogs reach 68 degrees latitude in Alaska, beyond most frogs' 45-degree limit.
